items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: Because GAR of Bina is entirely Hassadim, and the matter of going out does not apply to it, since no restriction was ever upon the light of Hassadim. Hence the ascent of the bottom Hey to the eyes does nothing to it. Hence the body and crown that remain at the degree always include with them also the GAR of Bina, and the matter of going out begins only from ZAT of Bina downward. (Inner Light, page 665, Sub Header, “And the Reason”)
